questions.question: What is the Physical Layer of the OSI model?
questions.answer: The Physical Layer is responsible for transmitting raw bits over a communication medium.

questions.question: What is deep copy?
questions.answer: A deep copy duplicates the object as well as all objects referenced by it.

questions.question: When are lambda functions useful?
questions.answer: Lambda functions are useful for short, simple operations that are used temporarily.

questions.question: What is COMMIT?
questions.answer: COMMIT permanently saves all changes made during the current transaction.
